beats.label: S1 · The kiss at Clockworks
beats.text: At Clockworks Psychiatric Hospital, David kisses fellow patient Syd goodbye; they swap bodies and her uncontrolled use of his powers kills his friend Lenny.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes David, Syd, the body-swap rule, and the first proof that David's 'illness' is something else.

beats.label: S1 · Summerland extraction
beats.text: Melanie Bird's mutant team Summerland breaks David out of Division 3 and tells him his lifelong schizophrenia has really been his mutant powers manifesting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Defines the two sides — Summerland and Division 3 — that persist into S2, and reframes David's diagnosis as the show's central lie.

beats.label: S1 · The memories are wrong
beats.text: Guided memory work reveals David's past has been falsified — his childhood friend was really a man named Benny, not Lenny — and something has been hiding inside his mind for years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The turn from 'David is unwell' to 'David is occupied' — every later beat sits on this recognition.

beats.label: S1 · The Shadow King
beats.text: Cary finds a parasite in David that emerges wearing Lenny's face and admits it has puppeted him since childhood; Oliver names it Amahl Farouk, the Shadow King.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the antagonist who drives the next two seasons and reveals Lenny was never David's friend.

beats.label: S1 · The adoption secret
beats.text: Farouk reveals David's biological father hid him via adoption to protect him from the Shadow King, who found him anyway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the mysterious powerful father whose identity S3 will finally deliver.

beats.label: S1 · Farouk walled off
beats.text: Using Cary's device the team walls Farouk off inside David's mind; David wakes lucid for the first time and singlehandedly overpowers a Division 3 raid on Summerland.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First time we see David functional, and Division 3 begins negotiating with him rather than hunting him.

beats.label: S1 · Farouk escapes, orb takes David
beats.text: During Farouk's extraction he leaps into Oliver's body and escapes into the world; moments later a strange floating orb appears and abducts David from Summerland.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both cliffhangers that S2 opens on — Farouk loose in Oliver, David missing.

cliffhanger.text: David has just been freed from years of possession, but Farouk has escaped inside Oliver's body — and before David can catch his breath, a floating orb appears and carries him away.
questions: Who sent the orb, and where has David been taken?
Can Summerland reach Farouk before he rebuilds his full power?
What is Farouk planning now that he finally has a mutant body of his own?

characters.name: David Haller
characters.line: A profoundly powerful mutant misdiagnosed as schizophrenic for most of his life; newly aware of his abilities but abducted by a mysterious orb the moment he was freed of Farouk.

characters.name: Sydney 'Syd' Barrett
characters.line: David's girlfriend, a mutant who cannot be touched without swapping into another person's body; the emotional anchor who kept fighting for him through the possession.

characters.name: Amahl Farouk / Shadow King
characters.line: An ancient parasitic mutant who lived inside David since childhood; now escaped into Oliver's body and free in the world for the first time in decades.

characters.name: Lenny Busker
characters.line: David's supposed drug-addicted friend from Clockworks whose form Farouk wore inside his head; her original body is dead.

characters.name: Oliver Bird
characters.line: Melanie's telepath husband, rescued from twenty years lost on the astral plane only to be immediately hijacked by Farouk as his getaway vehicle.

characters.name: Melanie Bird
characters.line: Founder of the Summerland mutant sanctuary and the woman who convinced David he was not sick; she has now lost Oliver a second time.

characters.name: Cary Loudermilk
characters.line: Summerland's scientist and the one who identified Farouk as a parasite; shares his body with Kerry, a warrior who emerges when action is needed.
characters.note: Cary/Kerry body-sharing is important for later seasons.

characters.name: Ptonomy Wallace
characters.line: The Summerland memory mutant with perfect recall who guides David through his own past and can walk inside other people's minds.

beats.label: S2 · A missing year
beats.text: A year after the orb, David reappears claiming only hours have passed; Summerland and Division 3 now work together to stop Farouk from digging up his original buried body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the board — the two sides are allies now, and the whole season is a race for Farouk's body.

beats.label: S2 · Future Syd's ultimatum
beats.text: David is secretly contacted by a future version of Syd who warns that killing Farouk brings a plague that ends humanity, and orders him to help Farouk instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Motivates every choice David makes this season and is the excuse he clings to even after it looks like villainy.

beats.label: S2 · The double game
beats.text: David and present Syd covertly aid Farouk in searching for his body while trying to hide their double game from the rest of the team.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the trust collapse that drives the finale — every later reveal is a debt from this deception.

beats.label: S2 · Lenny in Amy's body
beats.text: Farouk murders David's sister Amy and reincarnates Lenny inside her body using stolen DNA; Lenny surrenders to Division 3 and tells David what was done.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Amy's death breaks the deal with Farouk and returns Lenny to the story as a real person for the first time.

beats.label: S2 · The desert race
beats.text: Vowing revenge for Amy, David races Farouk to a shifting desert where his body is buried; Ptonomy dies to a Farouk-planted delusion and is preserved in the Vermillion Mainframe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ptonomy's transfer into the Mainframe is the form he takes going forward, and the race is the season's spine.

beats.label: S2 · Farouk restored, David victorious
beats.text: Farouk reunites with his true body and full power; David defeats him only after Lenny activates the Choke, but Syd now knows David will one day cause the apocalypse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both the ostensible win and the moment the team fractures — Syd chooses to act on the future she was shown.

beats.label: S2 · David the villain
beats.text: When Syd tries to shoot him, David rewrites her memory and sleeps with her; confronted at Farouk's trial, David escapes with Lenny while a jailed Farouk quietly restores Syd's memory.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The full inversion — David becomes the antagonist S3 opens hunting, and Syd's restored memory is what motivates her.

cliffhanger.text: David has been exposed as a monster who assaulted Syd and fled with Lenny into hiding; Farouk sits arrested at the peak of his restored power, and the team he abandoned is left to hunt the man they trained.
questions: Where has David gone, and what will he do next?
Now that Syd remembers everything, will she be the one to bring him in?
Is Farouk still the greater danger, or is the future Syd warned about already unstoppable?

characters.name: David Haller
characters.line: Now trained in his powers but revealed as a manipulator who rewrote Syd's mind and assaulted her; fled with Lenny after his team turned on him.

characters.name: Sydney Barrett
characters.line: David's ex-girlfriend and victim; Farouk restored her memories so she now knows exactly what David did and what he will become.

characters.name: Amahl Farouk / Shadow King
characters.line: Reunited with his original body and at full strength, but captured by Division 3 at the moment of his triumph.

characters.name: Lenny Busker
characters.line: Alive again inside David's dead sister Amy's body — a corpse infused with her old DNA and consciousness by Farouk; escaped alongside David.

characters.name: Oliver Bird
characters.line: Freed from Farouk during the desert fight; three years later he is living happily with Melanie inside the astral plane.

characters.name: Melanie Bird
characters.line: Nearly broken by Oliver's second loss and briefly Farouk's puppet through her grief; now reunited with Oliver in the astral plane.

characters.name: Cary Loudermilk
characters.line: The team's scientist, still sharing his body with Kerry; helped build the Choke that finally beat Farouk and now knows David is a monster.

characters.name: Kerry Loudermilk
characters.line: The warrior who lives inside Cary and emerges for combat; killed the desert minotaur guarding Farouk's body.

characters.name: Ptonomy Wallace
characters.line: Summerland's memory mutant; his body died to a Farouk delusion and his consciousness was preserved inside the Vermillion Mainframe that houses Division 3's leader.

characters.name: Clark Debussy
characters.line: The Division 3 field officer, burned from David's first escape; now leads the ground pursuit of David alongside the mutants he once hunted.

beats.label: S3 · Switch finds the cult
beats.text: A young mutant nicknamed Switch, whose doorways can travel through time, is drawn to David's remote desert cult; in every timeline she witnesses, Syd tracks David down and kills him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the new arrival who makes the season possible and establishes that killing David is Syd's default outcome.

beats.label: S3 · Cary supercharges Switch
beats.text: David captures Cary and mind-controls him into enhancing Switch's powers, aiming to travel back and stop Farouk from ever possessing him as a baby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes David's entire plan and shows how far his coercion has escalated — his own former allies are now tools.

beats.label: S3 · The Xavier house
beats.text: In 1960s Morocco and at home with his parents, David watches helplessly as Charles and Gabrielle Xavier fail to stop past-Farouk from possessing baby David.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the show's biggest reveal — David is Charles Xavier's son — and sets up the truce that ends the show.

beats.label: S3 · Time cracks, Lenny breaks
beats.text: Time destabilises and time demons torture everyone through their worst memories; Lenny, sickened by David's villainy and her own, slits her throat before Cary escapes with Switch.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Loses Lenny for good and introduces the demons that will menace both sides of the finale.

beats.label: S3 · The airship massacre
beats.text: David boards Division 3's airship, throws Clark into space, wipes Syd's memory of who he is, recaptures Switch, and drags her back to erase Farouk himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: David's point-of-no-return act and the moment the team formally becomes his pursuers across time.

beats.label: S3 · Syd reborn
beats.text: Syd's stolen mind is reborn as a baby in the astral plane and raised to adulthood by Oliver and Melanie; grown, she returns to her body and follows David through time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reintroduces Syd as a whole person against David and pays off Oliver and Melanie's retirement from S2.

beats.label: S3 · The truce that erases them
beats.text: Present Farouk sides with David; Charles brokers a truce with both Farouks that spares David but erases the David and Syd of this timeline so a healed one can begin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's ending — the characters we followed dissolve to give a rewritten baby David a chance.

cliffhanger.text: Charles's truce with both Farouks spares his son but unwinds the future David and Syd had lived through; the timeline resets and the two of them fade away, hoping the new versions of themselves will find a better life.
questions: Will the new David grow up free of Farouk's shadow?
Can the peace between Charles and both Farouks actually hold once the old timeline is gone?
What becomes of the friends left behind in the world David unmade?

characters.name: David Haller
characters.line: The David we followed through three seasons: apocalypse-maker, cult leader, and Charles Xavier's son, erased along with his future when the truce rewrote the timeline.

characters.name: Sydney Barrett
characters.line: David's ex who lived a second childhood in the astral plane before returning to hunt him; erased with David when the timeline reset.

characters.name: Switch
characters.line: A young mutant whose doorways travel through time; her father revealed she can command the time demons and elevated her to a higher plane.

characters.name: Amahl Farouk / Shadow King
characters.line: Now split between his past and present selves; the present-day one struck a truce with Charles Xavier to spare David and end the war.

characters.name: Charles Xavier
characters.line: David's telepath father, a war veteran and builder of Cerebro; brokered the truce between David and the Farouks and reunited with his wife.

characters.name: Gabrielle Xavier
characters.line: David's mother, a Holocaust survivor tormented by Farouk while caring for the newborn David; reconciled with Charles at the end.

characters.name: Lenny Busker
characters.line: Ravaged by David's cult and the time demons, she took her own life in front of David after finally naming him a villain.

characters.name: Cary Loudermilk
characters.line: Broke free of David's mind control, hid Switch, and led the team into the past; now permanently separated from Kerry after transferring her wounds to himself.

characters.name: Kerry Loudermilk
characters.line: Physically separated from Cary and aged rapidly by their split; reunited with him after the fight, no longer sharing one body.
